claims.sentence: The objectives of the review are to (a) present clear guidance around the amount, type and frequency of physical activity for achieving health gain in older adults (>65 years of age), (b) discuss the measurement of physical activity, (c) present the evidence for health benefit of increased physical activity for older adults and (d) discuss the extent to which older adults achieve the suggested physical activity guidelines with suggestions on how to improve uptake and maintenance of high levels of physical activity.
